hero.title: ESO Addons Manager
hero.subtitle: Your add-ons. Simplified.
hero.description: Install, update and organize your The Elder Scrolls Online add-ons and libraries from a single desktop application. Manage dependencies, scan existing add-ons and keep your setup synchronized.

screenshot.alt: ESO Addons Manager catalogue with add-on filters, detailed description and image previews

notice.title: Important notice before first use
notice.body: Before using ESO Addons Manager for the first time, back up your AddOns folder and verify that the selected folder is correct. Synchronization may delete files and add-ons that the manager does not manage.
bullets: Create a backup of your AddOns folder before your first synchronization.
Use Scan to discover existing add-ons and review the results before synchronizing.
Keep synchronization on launch disabled until your initial setup is complete and verified.
